attacks.name: Psionic Bolt
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.
|!failure| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender’s |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Telekinetic Force
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Battlefield Manipulation
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Matter Transmutation
superPowers.body: Choose another character with an Activated token within |!range| 2 and Push it |!range_small|. A character can be moved by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Shield Mind
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 4 of it would be Advanced, Placed, or Pushed by the effects of an enemy |!mystic| attack or enemy superpower, this character may use this superpower. The allied character is not Advanced, Placed, or Pushed.

superPowers.name: Latent Psychic Potential
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 7 to 8 on Injured side.
"Psionic Bolt" was added a Pierce special rule, triggering on |!failure|.
Power cost for "Telekinetic Force" decreased from 6 to 5.
"Latent Psychic Potential" gives 2 additional |!power| per Power Phase instead of 1.
